summary: Web UI: images, videos and audio inside a quoted post can now be clicked to open the media viewer/player (new openAttachmentGallery action) instead of the click taking you to the quoted post; quoted images show an ALT-text badge; the rest of the quote stays a link to the post. Frontend only.

statements.why: Client-side UI change only; no server, auth or data changes.

statements.text: Most of this change is in app/javascript/mastodon/components/status/image.tsx (71 lines added, 11 removed).

statements.why: Styling for the ALT badge; uninformative.
Styling/focus outline for clickable quote images; uninformative.

statements.text: The agent also changed interactions_typed.ts, image.tsx and quote.tsx, in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Clicking a picture, video or audio in a quoted post now opens it in the media viewer/player instead of opening the quoted post; quoted images also get an ALT badge.
